question: A 2-hour interview is cut down to a 3-minute segment on the news. What percentage of what was said is broadcast?
move: Ask what the other ninety-odd per cent of the conversation said.
ask: What did I conclude about someone from a clip that was a sliver of what they said?
trap: Assuming a clip is a fair sample of the whole conversation.
hint: Put both lengths in minutes first.
reference: Proportion of an interview broadcast, worked arithmetic, 2026
